# BOOM! Healthcare Communications

> BOOM! is a European healthcare communications agency that partners with pharmaceutical companies to build brands, educate audiences and drive advocacy.

## Source

This site concept is based on information published on [boom-cc.com](https://www.boom-cc.com/). Confirm all claims, assets and URLs with BOOM! before launch. The Work page presents the proposed case-study structure. Client stories and testimonials need BOOM-approved content because none were found on the live site.
